description: This Java class 'GroupSheetPopulator' is responsible for generating and populating an Excel sheet with group and office data, used within a bulk import feature of a larger application. It manages the layout, maps between office and group data, and writes relevant information into the sheet.

classes.name: GroupSheetPopulator
classes.description: A class that populates an Excel sheet with group and office data for bulk import operations.

methods.name: populate
methods.description: Creates a sheet, sets layout, populates data, and protects the sheet.

methods.name: setLayout
methods.description: Defines the layout and header row for the sheet.

methods.name: setOfficeToGroupsMap
methods.description: Builds a map from office names to associated group names.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a group name to the list associated with an office in the map.

methods.name: populateGroupsByOfficeName
methods.description: Fills the sheet with office and group information, tracking index ranges.

methods.name: setGroupNameToGroupIdMap
methods.description: Creates a map from group names to their IDs.
